_comment: Text the build rewrites or removes on its way to the public site.
Most clubs need nothing here — empty lists are a perfectly good answer, and
this file can be deleted entirely.
'redact' drops matter that belongs in your working sources but not on a page
players and parents read. Each entry is a regular expression, applied to
every doc. 'redactLines' drops whole lines containing any of its strings.
'redactCheck' is a last look: if it still matches after redacting, the build
'rewrite' fixes prose that reads correctly in the source file but not on the
site — mostly a reference to another document that ends up on the same page,
or one to a file that has no page at all. Keyed by the doc's filename, so a
rule keeps working wherever the doc lives; each entry is [find, replace],
matched literally. Write the replacement as plain text, not HTML — it is
escaped on the way out like everything else.
A rule that no longer matches is reported as a note, not an error: a reworded
sentence should never stop the site from publishing.
